## About
Eurotech Performance Group, or EPG, is one of the oldest European performance shops in North Atlanta. We started out working on water-cooled Volkswagens and grew into Porsche and Audi specialists. We don't just work on these cars. We own and drive them ourselves, so we know them inside and out.
We're a small shop on purpose. Brian Ettl owns the place and is still under the cars. Stephen King is our service advisor, so if you call or email, you'll probably talk with him. Owen Powell is our mechanic and resident Audi and VW specialist, and he works on Porsches too.
Our mission has always been honesty. We won't sell you parts or services you don't need, we'll give you the fairest price we can, and we stand behind our work.

## Services
- ECU tuning and upgrades: ECU tuning, suspension upgrades, exhaust, turbos, brakes and more for Porsche and Audi.
- Oil and transmission service: Oil service, transmission service, spark plugs and more, based on factory service tables.
- Check engine lights, leaks and misfires: We track down check engine lights, steering and suspension problems, exhaust leaks, misfires and coolant leaks.
- Pre purchase inspections: A detailed look at the cosmetic, mechanical and safety condition of a car you're thinking about buying.
- Cars & parts on consignment: We sometimes have cars and parts for sale on consignment. Ask what we have in right now.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in Porsche and Audi. Owen is our resident Audi and VW specialist, and he works on Porsches too.

Q: Can you check out a car I'm buying from far away?
A: Yes. Reviewers have bought cars sight unseen after Brian's PPI.

Q: Who will I talk to when I call?
A: Most likely Stephen, our service advisor. He handles a lot of our calls and emails.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
